snippet.title: Longplay of Pac-Man World 3
snippet.description:
NEW AND IMPROVED RECORDING: https://youtu.be/QkLMWJXoEkk

Longplay of Pac-Man World 3, played as the NTSC version on the GameCube. This game's version was released on Nov. 17th, 2005. Tell us what you think by leaving a comment down below!

1:03:02 - The Spectral Vale
1:23:33 - Zephyr Heights
1:41:59 - Boss: Gigatron
1:51:00 - Ancient Catacombs
2:12:19 - Gogekka Heights
2:33:15 - Banni Canyon
2:49:53 - Toc-Man Battle
2:54:33 - Cragstone Bridge
3:23:31 - Erwin's Fortress
3:48:17 - Dungen Gunden
4:09:52 - The Spectral Zenith
4:30:23 - Shadow Temple
4:36:57 - Final boss: Teradecahydratron
4:45:58 - Ending
4:48:39 - Credits
